en.name: Stilton
en.summary: Blue Stilton is firmer and drier than most blues, so it sits at the long end of the blue-cheese range: about 2–3 weeks in the fridge once opened. White Stilton is a different, younger, unveined cheese. Freezing is only worth it for soup and sauce.
en.pantry: Stilton is a fridge cheese. It is firm enough to look like a hard cheese, but underneath it is moist and low in acid, and a wedge left out warms, sweats and starts to run. Bring it out about half an hour before serving and put the rest back. While the wrapper is intact, the use-by date on the pack is the operative limit — a use-by date is a legal one in the UK, not a suggestion, and you may freeze right up to midnight on it.
en.fridge: Keep it at 0–5 °C with the cut face covered by waxed paper or foil and the rind left exposed, in a loosely closed box. Treat 2–3 weeks as the working limit once opened; that number is our own extrapolation between the published soft-cheese and opened-hard-cheese figures, on the reasoning that Stilton is drier than a gorgonzola dolce, and no agency publishes a Stilton figure. A whole or half truckle in its wrapper keeps longer than a cut wedge — the cut face is where it dries, browns and picks up stray moulds. Note the safety split that catches people out precisely because Stilton looks hard: pregnant, elderly and immunocompromised people are advised to avoid all blue-veined cheeses, unpasteurised and pasteurised alike.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given. Freeze Stilton only for soup and sauce: it thaws crumbly and wet, and the paste never recovers its texture. Cut it into cooking-sized lumps, double-wrap them at −18 °C (0 °F), and drop them straight into a hot soup. A better plan for a Christmas truckle is to portion it, give some away and eat the rest while it is at its best.
en.thawing: If you have frozen it, thaw it wrapped in the fridge and use it straight into a hot dish. Do not thaw it on the counter, and do not refreeze it.
spoilage: An ammonia smell that has taken over from the blue.
Fuzzy grey, pink or black growth on the cut face — the blue veining is the cheese, this is not.
A brown, translucent, weeping edge spreading in from the cut face.
A bitter or metallic taste, or a slimy rind.
tips: Cover the cut face and leave the rind breathing.
Keep a truckle whole until you need it; a cut face ages fast.
Wrap it twice — Stilton will flavour everything near it.
Use a strong-tasting end piece in a soup rather than binning it.

faq.q: How long does Stilton keep in the fridge?
faq.a: About 2–3 weeks once opened at 0–5 °C. While the wrapper is intact, follow the use-by date on the pack.
No timeline is given and it is only worth it for cooking. It thaws crumbly and wet and cannot go back on a board.
No. The advice covers all blue-veined cheeses, pasteurised or not, so whether a particular Stilton was made from pasteurised milk makes no difference. Cooked through, it is acceptable.

faq.q: Is White Stilton the same cheese?
faq.a: No. White Stilton is younger, unveined and much milder, and it is a different product with a shorter, fresher character.

zh.name: 斯蒂爾頓藍紋乳酪
zh.summary: 藍紋斯蒂爾頓比多數藍紋乳酪更結實、更乾，所以落在藍紋乳酪保存區間的長端：開封後冷藏約 2～3 週。白斯蒂爾頓則是另一種年輕、沒有藍紋的乳酪。冷凍只有煮湯做醬時才值得。
zh.pantry: 斯蒂爾頓是冷藏乳酪。它結實到看起來像硬質乳酪，但底下仍然濕潤、酸度低，一塊放在室溫會回溫、出汗、開始流動。上桌前約半小時拿出來，其餘冰回去。包裝完好時，以包裝上的有效日期為準——在英國，有效日期是法定界線而不是建議值，而且可以在到期當天午夜前冷凍。
zh.fridge: 放在 0～5 °C，切面用蠟紙或錫箔覆蓋、外皮裸露，裝進不完全密閉的盒子。開封後請把 2～3 週當成工作上限；這個數字是我們在「軟質乳酪」與「已開封硬質乳酪」兩個公告值之間的推估，理由是斯蒂爾頓比古岡左拉 dolce 乾，而且沒有機構公告過斯蒂爾頓的數字。整輪或半輪連原包裝比切開的楔形塊耐放——切面才是會乾掉、變褐、招來雜霉的地方。還有一個常讓人誤判的安全分野，正因為它看起來很硬：孕婦、長者與免疫力低下者被建議避開所有藍紋乳酪，不論是否巴氏殺菌。
zh.freezer: 這裡不給冷凍期限。斯蒂爾頓只有為了煮湯做醬才值得冷凍：解凍後又碎又濕，質地再也回不來。切成一次入菜的小塊，在 −18 °C 下包兩層，之後直接丟進熱湯。聖誕節整輪的更好做法是分裝、送人，剩下的趁最好吃時吃掉。
zh.thawing: 若已冷凍，請連包裝放冷藏解凍，直接下熱料理。不要放室溫解凍，也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 切面長出灰、粉紅或黑色絨毛霉——藍色紋路是乳酪本身，這些不是。
褐色、半透明並滲液的邊緣從切面往內蔓延。
吃起來發苦或有金屬味，或外皮發黏。
tips: 切面蓋好，外皮讓它呼吸。
要用之前都保持整輪；切面老化得很快。
包兩層——斯蒂爾頓會讓旁邊所有東西都變味。
味道太衝的尾料拿去煮湯，不要丟掉。

faq.q: 斯蒂爾頓乳酪冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 開封後在 0～5 °C 下約 2～3 週。包裝完好時請以包裝上的有效日期為準。
這裡不給期限，而且只有入菜才值得。解凍後又碎又濕，回不去起司盤。

faq.q: 懷孕可以吃斯蒂爾頓嗎？
faq.a: 不建議。建議涵蓋所有藍紋乳酪，不論是否巴氏殺菌，所以這一支是不是用殺菌乳做的並不影響。加熱煮透則可以。

faq.q: 白斯蒂爾頓是同一種乳酪嗎？
faq.a: 不是。白斯蒂爾頓年輕、沒有藍紋、味道溫和許多，是另一種產品，性格更接近新鮮乳酪。
